title: Add opencode as a verified worker kind
description:
Human-approved (2026-08-13): opencode joins claude/codex/pi as a worker kind. opencode CLI is installed at ~/.opencode/bin/opencode (NOTE: not on non-interactive PATH — export PATH="$HOME/.opencode/bin:$PATH" in your probes, and determine whether herdr agent start finds it or needs the full path/env in the template) and authenticated; the herdr opencode integration is installed (v9) for hook-based lifecycle.

Follow the established fourth-kind pattern — read internal/herd/config/kinds.go (esp. the codex row + ipo computed-extras seam), herdr-kinds.md, and repo-wiki/herd-helper-cli.md gotchas FIRST. Deliver, all live-verified per the herdr-kinds discipline (scratch panes, clean up everything you create, never touch panes/workspaces that are not yours, explicit targets always):

1. kinds.go row: full-auto/permission template (discover opencode current flags from --help — do not guess), model selection + effort mapping (opencode is multi-provider — expect provider-qualified ids like pi; verify the flag and whether effort/thinking exists), model-family compatibility rule (likely cross-provider), reserved args, computed extras if its sandbox blocks linked-worktree git metadata (test a commit from a worktree like the codex finding — if unsandboxed, note that and move on).
2. Live round trip in a scratch pane: herdr agent start with your template -> first-prompt behavior (green-start? silent drop?), agent_session timing (at start or post-prompt?), resume shape (flag vs subcommand), any one-time startup gates (codex had workspace-trust + hooks-review; watch for opencode analogs and clear them, documenting each), send-keys quirks.
3. herdr-kinds.md: full opencode row + sections (spawn/full-auto/resume/compat), dated observations (opencode <version>, 2026-08-13). runners-config.md: compatibility-matrix mention; add a worked example ONLY if it adds a new shape (a second cross-provider kind may not need one — judge, and validate any TOML you add against the schema with uv run --with jsonschema).
4. Tests: kinds/compile coverage incl. compatibility refusals for opencode; doc round-trip additions if you added doc argv lines; whole-suite green on real exits.
5. End-to-end proof: spawn a REAL opencode worker via tk herd spawn on a scratch-repo toy tick (build tk from your worktree), gate->prompt->collect round trip; capture evidence in your RESULT (do not commit it).

Boundaries: internal/herd/config (+spawn only if extras logic needs it), the two reference docs, tests. No .tick/ writes, no tk against the real tracker (scratch repo tk is fine, cwd discipline). gofmt/vet clean. Commit with prefix "tick <id>: ".
acceptance_criteria: kinds.go opencode row live-verified incl. full-auto/model/effort/resume/compat; startup gates documented+cleared; herdr-kinds.md + runners-config.md updated dated; compile/doc tests green; real opencode worker completes a toy tick end-to-end via tk herd (evidence in RESULT)
